name: JWT Decoder
summary: Decode a JSON Web Token's header and payload without verifying — all in your browser.
description: Paste a JWT to inspect its header and payload as formatted JSON. Human-readable timestamps are shown for standard time claims. Decoding is local and never verifies or exposes secrets.

faqs.question: Does this verify the signature?
faqs.answer: No. It only decodes the token so you can read the claims. It never checks the signature and you should never paste production secrets.

faqs.question: Is my token sent anywhere?
faqs.answer: No. Decoding happens entirely in your browser.

faqs.question: Why does it show ISO dates?
faqs.answer: Standard claims like iat, exp and nbf are Unix timestamps. We convert them to readable ISO dates for convenience.
